result.prior_version_note: For notices served 3/1/25–2/28/26, the payment was $8,062.00 per tenant, with a maximum of $24,184.00 per unit, plus $5,375.00 for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren). The earliest archived period (8/10/06–2/28/07) was $4,500.00 per tenant, $13,500.00 maximum per unit, plus $3,000.00. The 2006 start date is taken from the earliest row in the rate archive; the documents do not state an enactment date.
